findings.title: Partial refund amount is ignored and full order total is refunded
findings.evidence: The function comment states the input is the approved partial refund amount, but the new call sends the full order total to the gateway instead of the requested amount. Any caller invoking refund(order, amount_cents) for a partial refund will now issue a full refund.
findings.recommendation: Pass the approved refund amount through to the gateway, e.g. use amount_cents here, and add a test covering partial refunds to prevent regressions.
